notes.v1_3: Review pass 1 and decisions D1–D6 folded (REVIEW_PASS1_DISPOSITION_v1_0.md). Items depend only on items; a native act is an item with done_by decision whose id is a decisions-log id.
notes.new_detector_types: prs_merged, main_has_files, scorecard_pass, migrations_applied, register_rows_state, register_freeze_clean, monitor_check_ok, deployed_contains, wave_deployed, assets_elevated, registry_coverage, ledger_no_open_gap_on — built by L.13 (arch §11.7). Until then they read unknown, never done.
notes.pinned_by: A detector spec with an empty list and pinned_by names the item that must fill it (paths or PR numbers) in the same commit as that item; empty means unmeasured, never done.

tracks.title: Launch readiness

tracks.title: Track A — Analysis, all layers

tracks.plain: Three family sessions (Gochara, Saṅgam, Kṣetra) each seal a final brief and implement it; not gated by J1; Suvarṇa evaluates and later certifies

tracks.title: J1 — The join
tracks.plain: One combined reopen of the founding documents, then the engine freeze on one checklist

tracks.title: Track I — Implementation
tracks.plain: Fixes for every layer, in parallel lanes

tracks.title: Track B — Rebuild and certify
tracks.plain: Per wave: fixes merged to main and deployed, one rebuild per dependency level, certify; family assets and their readers certified asset by asset; layer closes
